# MasterVLSI

> India's premier VLSI training institute in Bengaluru. Design & Verification focus (RTL, SystemVerilog, UVM), FPGA prototyping, SoC integration. Placement in 30–45 days at Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Synopsys, Cadence and 60+ semiconductor companies.

MasterVLSI has been training semiconductor engineers since 2015. 5000+ alumni placed. 16 industry mentors. 24/7 EDA lab with Synopsys VCS, Cadence Xcelium, Mentor Questa and full backend tool stack. Campus at Udayanagar Main Road, near Tin-Factory bus stop, Bangalore – 560016.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2015, Bengaluru, India
- Alumni: 5000+
- Placement window: 30–45 days after course completion
- Focus: Design (RTL) and Verification (UVM) — not Physical Design
- Modules: 15 industry-aligned VLSI training modules
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 98449 82345 · hr@mastervlsi.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@mastervlsi2526 (200+ free tutorials)

## Pages

- [Home](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/): Overview, program pillars, mentor manifesto, cohort highlights, FAQs.
- [About](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/about): Institute story since 2015, mentors, campus location, PG accommodation, transit connectivity from Bengaluru rail and metro.
- [Courses](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/courses): 15 modules — RTL Design, Design Verification (UVM), FPGA Prototyping, Embedded Systems, SoC Integration, Low Power Design, Post-Silicon Validation, ASIC Design, CDC, IP Development, AMS Verification, VLSI Flow Automation and more.
- [Services](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/services): NDA-friendly silicon engineering services — RTL, DV, CDC, IP, SoC integration, flow automation — for fabless startups and enterprises.
- [Placements](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/placements): Hiring partners, alumni video testimonials, Google reviews, salary heatmap, placement journey, achievements strip.
- [Playlists](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/playlists): Curated YouTube playlists covering VLSI fundamentals through advanced topics — Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, interview prep.
- [Blog](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/blog): Technical guides on RTL, DV, CDC, low-power design, static timing, interview preparation and career deep-dives.
- [Demo](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/demo): Book a free 60-minute demo class — on-site in Bengaluru or online. Meet mentors, tour the lab.
- [Contact](https://vlsiviz-sparkle.lovable.app/contact): Address, phone, WhatsApp, email, campus map.
